discovery_ledger.metaphor_removal_rule: All source phrases and motif names can be removed without changing the formal objects and obligations below.
discovery_ledger.interpretation_limit: Fear is a name for an unresolved machine obligation in this design, not an assertion that a model experiences fear.

inputs.F0: Immutable original CNF byte string, variable map and source hash.
inputs.tau: Exact transformation trace with immutable checkpoints, operator identifiers, complete certificate payloads or resolvable pinned payloads, and reconstruction metadata.
inputs.P: Finite provenance DAG (V,E). An edge u->v means v's recorded derivation/check reads evidence object u. Dependency completeness must be justified by the trace format.
inputs.o: A frozen, precisely stated currently unresolved obligation with the evidence objects it reads.
inputs.catalog: A finite preregistered catalog of admitted, deterministic, certificate-producing local interface transformations; no learned proposal is an admitted transformation without certification.
inputs.limits: Explicit finite budgets for time, representation size, boundary width, certificate size and decoder cost.

actors.authority: May suggest diagnostic regions and representations; cannot validate its own output by score or fluency.
Checks bytes, complete trace dependencies and reproducible checkpoints.
Applies only admitted deterministic macros; otherwise returns OPEN.
Checks full certificate obligations and reconstruction against the pinned source, when a future implementation exists.
Preserves source, candidates, failures, scope and receipts without rewriting earlier records.

operations.name: CHECK_SOURCE_AND_TRACE
operations.precondition: The requested source, operator and verifier identities are pinned.
operations.action: Validate content hashes, resolve all evidence references, and check that the recorded checkpoint needed by o is reproducible under the frozen rules.
operations.output: Verified diagnostic inputs or an explicit unresolved state.
operations.receipt: Pinned hashes, checked references, missing objects and exact failed obligation; cached route summaries are not full replay traces.

operations.name: BACKWARD_PROVENANCE_SLICE
operations.precondition: P is acyclic and its dependencies are complete for the claimed diagnostic scope.
operations.action: Compute A = ancestor_closure_P(seeds(o)) using reverse graph traversal.
operations.output: A reproducible dependency slice with original event IDs.
operations.receipt: Seed IDs, edge-set identity, visited node IDs and work consumed.
operations.boundary: A provenance slice identifies recorded dependencies, not causal necessity, a minimum unsatisfiable core or graph treewidth.

operations.name: LOCALIZE_NONPASS_FRONTIER
operations.precondition: The checker c is independently defined with PASS, FAIL and UNKNOWN outputs; the order is the DAG order.
operations.action: Let N={v in A : c(v) != PASS}. Return M={v in N : no proper ancestor of v in A belongs to N}, with FAIL and UNKNOWN tags preserved.
operations.output: All minimal nonpass nodes, including incomparable nodes. If N is empty and o remains unresolved, return VALID_TRACE_OBSTRUCTION_UNEXPLAINED.
operations.receipt: Per-node check results and the selected frontier.
operations.boundary: Do not use binary search without a proved monotonic predicate. A minimal nonpass location is a diagnostic boundary, not a proved root cause. A valid trace can still leave a hard or wide residual.

operations.name: EXTRACT_CLOSED_SOURCE_BLOCK
operations.precondition: U is a nonempty subset of vars(F). Region selection and ordering are recorded. Selection is advisory, not a completeness argument.
operations.action: Take C_U to be every clause of F containing any variable in U. Set B=vars(C_U) minus U and F_out=F minus the selected clause occurrences. Validate that U has no occurrence in F_out.
operations.output: F=F_out(B,Z) AND C_U(B,U), source clause IDs and exact boundary variable map.
operations.receipt: Complete source clause occurrence list, boundary/internal variable sets and incidence checks.
operations.boundary: No clause may be omitted to make the candidate easier. Region selection does not assign Boolean variables.

operations.name: COMPILE_EXACT_BOUNDARY_CANDIDATE
operations.precondition: A catalog macro applies with its exact preconditions and budget.
operations.action: Propose an explicit representation H(B,A_aux), certificate pi and witness maps encode/decode for R_U(B)=exists U C_U(B,U).
operations.output: A candidate tuple (H,pi,encode,decode), not an accepted solver replacement.
operations.receipt: Macro identity, full certificate payload, source linkage, representation and boundary sizes, decoder/encoder bounds.
operations.boundary: R_U is a mathematical definition, not an instruction to construct an exponential truth table. No DPLL, assignment branching, hidden oracle or exhaustive production fallback is introduced.

operations.name: VERIFY_CONTEXTUAL_SUBSTITUTION
operations.precondition: All obligations C01-C07 below have the required evidence and the independent checker can process it within limits.
operations.action: Check both directions for every boundary assignment symbolically or through an appropriate certificate, and verify constructive lifting to the exact source.
operations.output: CERTIFIED_LOCAL_SUBSTITUTION for the precisely scoped block, or REJECTED/OPEN.
operations.receipt: Verifier identity, input hashes, certificate bytes, accepted scope, reconstruction results and all costs.
operations.boundary: A local substitution receipt is not a theorem about arbitrary inputs, a complete decision algorithm, or a change to a sealed reducer.

operations.name: ARCHIVE_OBSTRUCTION_AND_CONTROL_RETRY
operations.action: Append the exact reason, falsifier or missing obligation. A later retry needs a recorded relevant change, and creates a child attempt; it never rewrites the old outcome.
operations.output: An append-only receipt and, only for a separately authorized future experiment, an eligible retry description.
operations.receipt: Parent attempt hash, relevant changed premise/evidence and invariant claim scope.
operations.boundary: An attractive new phrase, changed score, elapsed time or additional model endorsement is not a discharged obligation.

exact_interface_contract.variable_sets: B, U, Z and A_aux are finite and pairwise disjoint where present. F_out uses only B and Z; C_U uses only B and U; H uses only B and A_aux.
exact_interface_contract.required_equivalence: For every b: (exists u C_U(b,u)) iff (exists a H(b,a)).
exact_interface_contract.completeness: For every b,u satisfying C_U, encode(b,u) returns a satisfying H(b,a). If H has no auxiliary variables, a is the empty tuple.
exact_interface_contract.soundness_and_reconstruction: For every b,a satisfying H, decode(b,a) returns u satisfying C_U(b,u).
exact_interface_contract.contextual_consequence: For every external CNF F_out(B,Z): SAT(F_out AND C_U) iff SAT(F_out AND H). The B,Z values are preserved; only internal or auxiliary coordinates are replaced.
direct_argument: Given a model (b,z,u) of F_out AND C_U, completeness produces a, and F_out is unchanged because it does not read U or A_aux.
Given a model (b,z,a) of F_out AND H, soundness produces u, and F_out remains satisfied for the same b,z.
These two witness transformations establish the stated contextual equivalence under the listed preconditions.
sat_unsat_asymmetry: H-to-source reconstruction alone is enough to lift a particular validated SAT witness, but not to infer source UNSAT from H UNSAT.
Source-to-H completeness is also required before a verified UNSAT result on H may transfer to the source.
Certificate rejection and OPEN are not formula UNSAT.

obligations.name: SOURCE_BLOCK_CLOSED
obligations.requirement: All clauses incident to U are included, variable maps are exact, and the original checkpoint is verified.

obligations.name: COMPLETENESS
obligations.requirement: A justified C_U -> exists A_aux H direction, with the specified encoder or equivalent proof.

obligations.name: SOUNDNESS
obligations.requirement: A justified H -> exists U C_U direction.

obligations.name: CONSTRUCTIVE_SOURCE_WITNESS
obligations.requirement: Decoder is explicit, covers every admitted H witness, and its cost is accounted for.

obligations.name: SOURCE_PRESERVING_INDEPENDENT_CHECK
obligations.requirement: An independent checker replays the actual certificate against exact pinned source objects.

obligations.name: REPRESENTATION_AND_COST
obligations.requirement: H, certificate, trace, boundary, compile, check and reconstruction costs satisfy the claim's explicit bounds.

obligations.name: CONTEXT_AND_SCOPE
obligations.requirement: The external context does not access eliminated internal variables; any deployment is scoped and separately authorized.

exact_interface_contract.marginalization_warning: The product of unary feasible-value sets can strictly contain R_U. It is an overapproximation unless exact factorization is independently proved.

statuses.PROVED_COUNTEREXAMPLE: The exact frozen claim remains refuted in its scope; any revised claim is a new child, not a repair of history.
statuses.CERTIFICATE_REJECTED: The proposed certificate failed; this is not by itself UNSAT or proof that no valid certificate exists.
statuses.MISSING_SOURCE_OR_TRACE: Return OPEN; acquire exact missing material before rechecking.
statuses.MISSING_RECONSTRUCTION: Return OPEN for the relevant transfer claim; a claimed inverse is not sufficient.
statuses.RESOURCE_LIMIT: Return OPEN_RESOURCE_LIMIT; a timeout is not a negative instance.
statuses.STRUCTURAL_LEMMA_OPEN: Verified local steps exist but the structural/global obligation is not discharged.

obstruction_record.retry_fingerprint: Relevant source/claim/operator/verifier identity plus evidence for the specific unresolved obligation. Cosmetic JSON or narrative changes do not qualify.
obstruction_record.uncertainty_rule: Preserve UNKNOWN if the record cannot distinguish these causes.

scheduler_pseudocode: In a separately authorized future implementation, accept only typed pinned inputs.
Check the source/trace; missing prerequisites -> emit OPEN receipt and stop.
Compute the dependency slice and tag the nonpass frontier; do not infer a universal structural cause.
Select a source-closed block deterministically from the recorded candidate region.
Try only applicable admitted catalog macros within an explicitly bounded attempt budget.
For each proposed H, verify both directions, source reconstruction, context closure and all claim-scoped costs.
Accepted H -> return a local substitution certificate for a separate experiment; failed/unknown -> preserve exact receipt.
Exhausted catalog or budget -> OPEN. Never invoke hidden search or modify the frozen current reducer.
formalization_ledger.graph_boundary: The provenance DAG P and the CNF incidence graph I(F) are different objects. Fast ancestry traversal does not establish small SAT treewidth or a width-reduction theorem.

worked_example.scope: Two explicit three-variable CNF blocks; a local explanatory check, not a TRUMP gate or a benchmark.
worked_example.distinguishing_point: Both cases have unary supports x in {0,1}, y in {0,1}, yet their joint boundary relations are disjoint. Unary summaries cannot determine the hidden relation.
worked_example.outside_context: F_out = x AND NOT y. The equality block is inconsistent with this context; replacing it by the Cartesian product of unary supports incorrectly admits a model.
worked_example.interpretation: The useful operation is recovery of the exact shared constraint from source clauses with a certificate, not invention of a constraint from a suggestive image or model answer.
worked_example.execution_boundary: The 16 assignment evaluations enumerate only the two fixed illustrative truth tables to check the displayed equations. They are not a fallback in the proposed production algorithm.

declared_resolution_steps_check.scope: Declared parent clause indices and resolvents in this JSON

symbols.L: Bytes of the supplied input, trace and certificate representation
symbols.Q: Bounded number of proposed macro attempts
symbols.h_i: Explicit size of proposed interface representation

complexity_and_completeness.dependency_slice_bound: O(|V|+|E|) graph work using explicit adjacency lists, plus input parsing and K; this is a bound in the supplied graph size.
complexity_and_completeness.frontier_bound: A DAG topological pass can propagate whether a nonpass ancestor exists in O(|V|+|E|), after local checker costs are paid.
complexity_and_completeness.attempted_total: Input/checkpoint reconstruction cost + O(|V|+|E|+K) + sum_{i=1..Q} T_i + archive cost.
critical_limits: The trace and certificates may themselves be superpolynomial in |F0|; polynomial cost in L does not prove polynomial cost in |F0|.
A boundary truth table has 2^|B| entries; no general compactness guarantee is supplied.
A decoder may be expensive even when H is small; decoder cost is part of the contract.
Trying many regions, macros or epochs can create a superpolynomial total; all are counted.
No proof is provided that an admitted macro exists for every stalled input or that repeated substitution reaches a tractable terminal.
The local worked example does not prove a residual-width funnel, a reduction-stable obstruction, H1/H2/H3, or P=NP.
complexity_and_completeness.production_policy: If an applicable certificate-producing bounded macro is unavailable, return OPEN. This candidate is intentionally not a complete SAT decision procedure.

prior_art_and_delta.equality_example: The displayed resolution elimination is an illustration of established elimination mechanics, not a claimed new SAT rule.
prior_art_and_delta.local_design_delta: Organize diagnostics by source dependencies and typed blockers, then require exact contextual interface preservation for any candidate replacement. This is a proposed integration order, not established novelty or measured improvement.
prior_art_and_delta.valid_trace_warning: If every recorded transformation is sound, this diagnostic layer may find no defect and provide no simpler interface. A wide residual still requires its own formal structural explanation.

prerequisites: Explicit task authority for the specific nonsealed experiment
Concrete runtime/checker code and frozen hashes
Frozen input family, selectors, catalog and attempt budget
comparisons: Same authorized inputs and compute budget with and without provenance-directed region selection
Exact joint-interface check versus deliberately lossy unary-summary negative control
Complete trace versus missing-trace control that must remain OPEN
Valid but structurally obstructed trace where no artificial failure is invented
future_evaluation_contract.acceptance_scope: First establish correctness and cost accounting. Effectiveness requires actual controlled evidence; no result is implied here.

preserved_execution_boundaries.attribution: Previously established user context; no new Lane B raw-evidence validation is claimed in this artifact.

open_obligations: Any global structural or complexity theorem
